kiribati.title: Flag of the Republic of Kiribati

colors.note: The upper field representing the sky
The lower wavy stripes representing the Pacific Ocean
Three wavy stripes and separators representing the three island groups
The rising sun and the frigatebird

desc:
- Red upper half with a rising golden sun of seventeen rays and a golden frigatebird in flight; lower half has three wavy white stripes alternating with three wavy blue stripes
- Adopted on 12 July 1979, the day Kiribati gained independence from the United Kingdom
trivia:
- The seventeen rays of the sun stand for the sixteen Gilbert Islands plus Banaba
- The three pairs of wavy stripes represent the three island groups: the Gilbert, Phoenix, and Line Islands
- The frigatebird is a symbol of power, freedom, and the traditional seafaring culture of the I-Kiribati people
